preconditions.description: The length of permutations p and s is between 1 and 2000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in p) and len(p) == n and len(set(p)) == n
preconditions.description: p is a permutation of numbers from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in s) and len(s) == n and len(set(s)) == n
preconditions.description: s is a permutation of numbers from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The first line of stdout is a non-negative integer representing the minimum total coins required.
The second line of stdout is a non-negative integer k (0 ≤ k ≤ 2·10^6) representing the number of swap operations.

postconditions.expression: operations := [tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.splitlines()[2:2+int(stdout.splitlines()[1])]]; all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n and i != j for i, j in operations)
postconditions.description: Each of the next k lines contains two distinct integers i and j (1 ≤ i, j ≤ n, i ≠ j) representing valid swap operations.

postconditions.expression: p_copy := p.copy(); total_coins := 0; for i, j in operations: p_copy[i-1], p_copy[j-1] = p_copy[j-1], p_copy[i-1]; total_coins += abs(i - j); total_coins == int(stdout.splitlines()[0]) and p_copy == s
postconditions.description: The sequence of operations transforms p into s with the minimum total coins (sum of |i-j| for each swap).
